policy: If the headless Copilot backend (tools/copilot-agent.mjs) runs out of usage/credits, the Director (big-pickle) completes the assigned task directly, keeping Jev (jev-latest) in the process as the required batched auditor. Fallback does not skip the Jev eval gate; it changes only the executing model, never the audit or sign-off chain.
rationale: Copilot free tier is finite; C1 must not block on backend outage. Jev independence is preserved because the audit question set, thresholds, and batched one-call rule are unchanged.
